text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement a designated on-street accessible loading zone, in front of the main entrance to Annette Street Public School, located on the north side of Jennings Avenue. The establishment of an accessible loading zone will provide unimpeded curbside access for pick-up and drop-off of students with accessible permits. This proposal will not result in the loss of any permit parking spaces.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate from 7:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays, on the north side of Jennings Avenue, between a point 65 metres west of Clendenan Avenue and a point 9.6 metres further west. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 9:30 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. and from 1:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays, on the north side of Jennings Avenue, between a point 65 metres west of Clendenan Avenue and a point 9.6 metres further west. 3. Rescinded the existing maximum 10-minute parking in effect from 7:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m., from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays, on the north side of Jennings Avenue, between a point 65 metres west of Clendenan Avenue and a point 9.6 metres further west.
